operations.title: 1252 — The Full Kummer Module Has Eight Cyclic Character Orbits
operations.body: C5 acts on the 32 Kummer characters with orbit sizes 1,1,5,5,5,5,5,5. Hence the cyclic-invariant character sector has dimension 8, while the full deck-stable module remains rank 32. Reduction may exploit eight orbit blocks but may take invariants only after differential and physical-cycle equivariance.

operations.title: Benincasa decomposes the full Kummer module into eight cyclic character orbits
operations.body: Entry 1252: C5 acts on the 32 deck characters with two fixed masks (empty/full) and six free size-five orbits, so the invariant sector is rank 8. This is symmetry-adapted bookkeeping, not a replacement of the rank-32 cover. Next test is whether de Rham reduction and the physical top-form class close equivariantly on those eight orbit sums.
